verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an indirect path to one-to-one sends: a Create Event API (klaviyo-docs-30, klaviyo-docs-43) whose events can trigger flows that send branded notifications to individual recipients (klaviyo-docs-17). Campaigns are also created through the same API (klaviyo-docs-7). However, nothing in the pack documents a direct send-a-transactional-email endpoint, so receipts or magic links must go through flow configuration rather than a single API call. missing for 10: a direct transactional send API endpoint, documentation of transactional-specific handling (e.g. receipts, magic links, bypassing marketing consent), delivery-status guarantees for transactional mail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
